summary_1line: Krishna urges Karna to join the Pandavas as Kunti’s eldest son and king, but Karna refuses out of loyalty to his foster parents and Duryodhana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna stands beside Karna’s chariot revealing his royal birth while Karna listens in troubled silence beneath the open sky.
Karna recalls the humble charioteer couple Adhiratha and Radha lovingly caring for the abandoned infant they found.
Krishna describes a vision of Karna crowned king while the Pandavas stand around him holding royal emblems and chauris.
